title: Tennis | Calm Joints
description: A short tennis kit for between matches, and a video assessment with a registered physiotherapist.
sub: Tennis asks a lot of shoulders, elbows, knees and feet: serves, wide steps, long matches. Here’s a short kit for between matches, and a video assessment with a registered physiotherapist if you’d like to talk through how you move.

club_nudge.example: For country, tennis, and golf-and-tennis clubs, this helps members with tennis elbow, shoulder strain, and the load that comes with years on court.
club_nudge.tier1: Display a co-branded QR code. Anyone who books through it gets sessions with registered therapists across the province. The club earns a 25% payout on net revenue from those bookings.
club_nudge.tier2: A co-branded member store at wholesale rates, with physiotherapy built in.
